---
title: Meet the team
---

This project was developed by **The Statsbusters** for [STA 199: Introduction to Data Science](https://sta199-f26.github.io/) at Duke University.
The team is comprised of the following team members.

-   Erin Gilbert: Senior majoring in Physics, who joined the team after realizing that the unexplained phenomena she studies are mostly missing data.
-   Abby Yates: Junior majoring in Biology with a minor in Statistical Science, and the team's most enthusiastic believer that every dataset is hiding something.
-   Jillian Holtzmann: Sophomore majoring in Mechanical Engineering, who builds the team's ggplot themes with the same energy she brings to her proton packs.
-   Patty Tolan: First-year student planning to major in History, who knows every city in the dataset and checks that our numbers make sense in the real world.
